title: Saved-demo cloud read failure is reported as a missing demo
surface: Guidance preview and describe_demo/replay_demo on-miss repair
auth_mode: signed-in, cloud body needed after local cache miss
reproduction: Open a synced demo reference in a browser whose local demo body has not yet hydrated.
Make the extend.wbx_demo read fail while preserving the reference.
Open the Guidance preview or invoke describe_demo or replay_demo for that id.
expected: A database refusal or outage is shown as a load failure with a remedy and retry; a genuinely absent or tombstoned body remains a distinct missing-demo result.
actual: fetchDemoRow returned null after console.warn, getDemoOrHydrate also returned null on a thrown repair error, and the callers presented a missing body or missing demo.
severity: S2: a real saved workflow looks lost when its cloud body cannot be read
priority: P1: the failure erases the distinction between outage/refusal and absence on replay
root_cause: The demo read helpers answered database errors with success-shaped null or empty arrays; the on-miss repair caught thrown failures and converted them to null again. The sign-in bulk hydrate already has an honest ok:false retry path once the read throws.
verification_status: Focused demo tests passed (2 files, 16 tests), compile passed, swallowed-refusals check passed with tighter budgets. Full release139 checks passed and independent source review accepted the bounded correction. Native verification remains unverified; no closure is claimed.

transition_history.reason: Strict release gate identified a swallowed database refusal on fetchDemoRow.
